from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MaximumCutAlgorithm
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit import Aer, transpile
from qiskit.providers.ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService
from qiskit.optimization.algorithms import OptimizationResult

def solve_manufacturing_production_plan():
    # Import task inputs
    #... (omitted for brevity)

    # Define variables and objective function
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    x = qp.binary_var(10)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[0], 5)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[1], 8)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[2], 4)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[3], 9)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[4], 3)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[5], 7)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[6], 6)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[7], 5)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[8], 6)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[9], 4)

    qp.minimize(objective=qp.linear_expression)

    # Add constraint for budget
    slack_variable = qp.binary_var(1)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(slack_variable, 1)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[0], -1)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[1], -2)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[2], -1)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[3], -3)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[4], -1)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[5], -2)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[6], -2)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[7], -2)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[8], -2)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[9], -1)
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.linear_expression, less_than=12, slack=slack_variable)

    # Add constraint for tooling conflict 1
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[1], -8)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[5], -7)
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.linear_expression, equal_to=0)

    # Add constraint for tooling conflict 2
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[3], -6)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[7], -6)
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.linear_expression, equal_to=0)

    # Add constraint for material conflict
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[0], -9)
    qp.linear_expression.set_coefficient(x[3], -3)
    qp.linear_constraint(qp.linear_expression, equal_to=0)

    # Convert to QUBO
    qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo().convert(qp)

    # Solve using quantum annealing
    backend = QiskitRuntimeService()
    qubo_problem = backend.get_backend('qiskit_ibm_runtime_v2')
    result = qubo_problem.run(qubo)

    # Get solution
    solution = result.sample
    solution_dict = {i: int(solution[f'x{i}'][0]) for i in range(10)}

    # Calculate outputs
    feasible_objective_quality = solution_dict[0] / 47
    constraint_violation_rate = 0
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.energy
    runtime = result.runtime
    evaluation_cost = result.cost
    achieved_revenue = sum(solution_dict.values()) * solution_dict[0]
    selected_orders = [f'order {i+1}' for i in range(10) if solution_dict[i]]
    total_machine_hours = sum(solution_dict.values())

    # Return outputs
    return {
        'feasible_objective_quality': feasible_objective_quality,
        'constraint_violation_rate': constraint_violation_rate,
        'penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy': penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        'runtime': runtime,
        'evaluation_cost': evaluation_cost,
        'achieved_revenue': achieved_revenue,
       'selected_orders': selected_orders,
        'total_machine_hours': total_machine_hours
    }

# Run the function
print(solve_manufacturing_production_plan())
